sheets.title: ROOF SNOW, ICE & DRAINAGE
sheets.subtitle: Cold-weather drainage, fan protection and maintenance requirements.

notes.title: SNOW / ICE LOAD
notes.body: Design frame, fan supports and guards for site snow, drift, ice, wind and maintenance loads. Transfer to rails / posts / foundations; no load credit from operating heat.

notes.title: DRAINAGE
notes.body: Pitch collector pans at least 1:80; provide primary and visible emergency discharge paths to exterior collection. Trace / insulate exposed drains; keep discharge away from doors and switchgear.

notes.title: FAN START / ICE
notes.body: Temperature, fan proving and vibration / imbalance trip. If obstructed or iced: stop and lock out affected fans; alarm and transfer heat to chiller / reduce IT. Inspect and de-ice before restart.

notes.title: SERVICE ACCESS
notes.body: Use a maintenance lift at long sides; fans lift vertically and coils withdraw sideways. Do not stand on guards. Site access / fall protection and a snow-removal method must be engineered.

notes.title: FREEZE SURVIVAL
notes.body: Select glycol for the actual minimum fluid temperature. Drain heat reserve 2 kW/roof is inside the existing <=35 kW essential-heat target. Prove generator load and heat-loss budget.

notes.title: PRODUCT SELECTION
notes.body: Reference fan -25 to +50 C limits do not qualify -40 C operation. Specify the actual cold-start and hot-discharge limits. No automatic fan reversal or defrost cycle is assumed.
